segments.en:
What's behind this? What made the weight
drop by three kilos?!

We changed the material of the frame
around the cockpit.

It's actually stronger now, so it's
absolutely not dangerous.

Well, obviously! If it got any weaker,
we'd be in real trouble! Why didn't you
notify us in advance...

If you hadn't moved the delivery date
up by ten whole days...
Then take that up with Char of Neo Zeon!

If he hadn't pulled off his meteor drop
this soon, we wouldn't be in this mess!

rows.notes: Seg 2 has no header; read as the Anaheim manager continuing. Seg 6: Chan continuing; 'he' = Char (male), [jp] rendered 'asteroid drop' (Fifth Luna).

segments.en:
Not having Lieutenant Amuro around at a time
like this sure makes me nervous.

This ship's okay, but the fleet's MS...
looks like they took a real beating.
Hey, Kanji, are we gonna be okay?

Amuro or no Amuro, we've got to hold our
own!
Kanji's right.

If we lean on Lieutenant Amuro for every
little thing, we can't call ourselves
real pilots!
But still~

Relax, Tapp. We won't make our move until
Amuro gets back.

Right now, our job is to protect this
fleet.

In that case, let's rest up good and
proper till the enemy shows!
Agreed!

We're still tracking the Neo Zeon fleet,
right?!
Yes, sir!

Good. We'll detach two ships from the
fleet to shadow the Neo Zeon fleet.

Once we've made contact with La Vie en
Rose and fully resupplied, we go after
the enemy fleet!

Show La Vie en Rose's current position on
the nav chart.

rows.notes: [jp] rendered 'Captain Amuro' ([jp] = Captain; same rank word Cameron uses for Kanji in row 8). Seg 5 (no header) = Kayra continuing; [jp] -> 'real pilots'. Seg 14 (no header) = Bright continuing.

segments.en:
The Clop-class we sent ahead has sent us
the Neo Zeon fleet's position.
Putting it on the nav chart.
We will now pursue the enemy fleet.
We'll settle this before they reach Sweetwater.

rows.notes: [jp] read as the Clop-class cruiser (glossary 'Clop-class'), not a ship name. | [proofread 3] decided spelling 'Sweetwater'; the term_fixes regex ('Sweet Water') misses it because the name is split across a line break

segments.en: The operation to drop Fifth Luna was Neo Zeon's first fleet battle as an army.

I have been moved by the work each of you
did in this operation.

Today, to bring these operations to a
close,

we will launch a diversion against the
Londo Bell fleet in pursuit of us.

It is a simple operation... but I want
you to carry out your mission and return
safely to Sweetwater.

Colonel, we'll use the 3rd Squadron for
the diversion.
I leave it to you, Captain Lyle.
Colonel, it's nearly time to depart.
I know.

Lyle, I'm heading to Londenion. I'm
counting on you for the rest.
Sir!

3rd Squadron, break off from the main
force! Head for the enemy fleet at once!
3rd Squadron here, mission acknowledged!!

You're early, Mr. Amuro. How's the Re-GZ
treating you?

It's not a bad machine, but they got the
better of me at Fifth Luna.
Against an opponent with Funnels, I need the Nu Gundam.

Rest assured. It looks like we'll just
about make the delivery date you asked
for.

...By the way, you said there was
something you wanted to show me.
Yes, right this way.
This is a sample of the "Psycho-Frame."

It's packed with computer chips as small
as metal particles.
In theory, it's a "new material" that should far outperform any conventional psycommu.
That's an incredible idea.

We used material with the same
performance as this in the Nu Gundam.
It's in the frame around the cockpit.

However, we haven't run any experiments
yet, so its capabilities are an unknown
quantity...

But this technology... you said even you
don't know much about it...

It's information that trickled over from
the materials development division.

That's why I want to keep testing the
frame even after we're back with the
unit.
I know, I know. You can have that one.
Huh, really? Thank you so much!
Chan obtained a Psycho-Frame sample.

What do you think, Mr. Amuro? We could
still take it out now, if you like.
No, leave the Psycho-Frame installed.

I'm taking the Nu Gundam back with me
right away.
Th-That's impossible!

It still needs three more days to be
combat-ready.
No way!
That's right, no way!

rows.notes: [jp] -> '3rd Squadron'. Seg 13: scene cuts to Anaheim; [jp] -> 'Mr. Amuro'. Seg 26 ([jp]) kept vague: 'even you don't know much about it' -- answered by seg 27 (info from another division). Seg 21: [jp] -> 'Psycommu' (library form). | [editorial 0] tense mix smoothed (was/has fought), per accuracy flag | [editorial 15] consistency: Funnels capitalised as in rows 11-12 and the corpus | [editorial 21] term: project decision is lowercase 'psycommu'

segments.en: Enemy fleet sighted!!

The enemy's on the move? What are they up
to?!

Anaheim's supposed to be keeping pace
with our movements...
Get Amuro on the line!
Understood!
Everyone, let's go!!
Roger!
Roger!
Roger!
Roger!
All right, enemy ship destroyed!
You did it, Kanji!

We're really getting the hang of this,
huh?

Hey! Enemy units are closing on the
fleet!! From the other side! They're
coming from another direction!
What?

This is bad! We've gotten too far from
the Ra Cailum!

We can't just sit around here. Come on,
let's get back!
Yeah!
Will we make it in time...?!
Where's the mobile suit team?!
They've broken through!!
Ngh! Intercept! Barrage!
Waaaagh!!

What are you doing?! Where's the Jegan
team?!!
The barrage is too thin!!
Hm? That's Kayra's machine!
Kayra! Do you read me?!!

You'll get hit by our own fire! Get
clear!!
Not bad, scurrying around like that!
A backup fleet?!
Is that it?!
That machine's not in our data...

The way they pulled back... that was
slick...

Sorry, Amuro. We fell right into the
enemy's trap.

Don't worry about it... That enemy's
tough...

More importantly, there should be a
civilian shuttle drifting somewhere
nearby.
Tow it to the Ra Cailum.
Got it.
The Nu Gundam has been deployed.
Amuro and Chan are rejoining their unit.

Drifting civilian shuttle recovered. All
crew and passengers are safe.

So that's the shuttle that dodged the
falling Fifth Luna... What a reckless
thing to do...

Show the people aboard to the officers'
mess. I'll go see how they're doing.
Please don't go any further than this!
Stay inside the officers' mess!
Oka~y!
Wow, so this is a Londo Bell ship.

Come to think of it, Hathaway, your dad's
in the military, right?
Yeah, that's right.
Ah, Captain Bright, this way.
Dad!!
...Hathaway?!

You... you were on that shuttle...? But
why?

I can't believe you're the captain of
this ship, Dad.
What about your mother and Cheimin?

Oh... um... I was the only one who
managed to get on the shuttle.
Excuse me, Captain...
What is it?

Actually, the Federation government's
Vice Chief of Staff was aboard that
shuttle...

Dad! It's thanks to that official that
I... got on the shuttle.

I see... You can tell me the details
later. Go to the mess and get some rest.
Oh... okay.
Come on! Hathaway!
Yeah!

This ship will now make all speed for
Londenion!
Londenion? Why?!
You're giving up the pursuit?!

Special orders from the government. We
can't refuse them...

The Vice Chief of Staff was on the
shuttle we just rescued.

What could a politician want at
Londenion...

Ra Cailum correcting course for
Londenion!

rows.notes: Seg 12-13: read as two different operators (seg 13 shouts at the Jegans). Seg 17 (no header) = operator continuing. Segs 20-23 Rezin; seg 25 Amuro about Rezin -> 'they' (gender unknown to him). [jp] -> 'Vice Chief of Staff' (not in glossary). Seg 54 [jp] -> 'that official' (avoids gender). Seg 48 [jp] -> Cheimin (library form). Seg 31 [jp] -> 'deployed'. | [accuracy 20] [jp] = a fleet arriving in support; 'Backup for the fleet' lost that what Rezin sees is a fleet | [proofread 8] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en: So this ship's heading for Londenion?

Yeah, we're breaking off the pursuit of
the Neo Zeon fleet.
How come... all of a sudden...?

The shuttle we rescued... it was on its
way to Londenion, apparently......
Wow~ So they really bend over backwards for civilians, huh...

Plus, the Ra Cailum's damage needs
repairing...

That's just the official line! The big
shot on that shuttle is some Federation
high-up, right?

That's supposed to be kept under wraps,
so... don't tell the rest of the staff,
okay?
Look! Hathaway, it was over here!
Quess! Hey, we're gonna get in trouble!
What's this? Civilians from the shuttle?
Hey there! You!
Hm?
Ah...! It's those guys...
I'm Quess Paraya!

I'm Kanji Akatsuki. You were a passenger
on the shuttle, right?
Yep, that's right!

Hey! Kanji, you're the one in charge
here, aren't you?
Well... yeah...
I knew it!

(She sure seems like a girl who does
things her own way...)

(But how did she know I was the one in
charge?)

(I don't think I really give off that
vibe...)

Hey! I want you to show me the mobile
suits.
Come on, please!

W-Well, see... civilians are supposed to
be banned from this floor...
That's why I'm asking you!
Quess! Don't bother them.

Hathaway, you're interested in mobile
suits too, aren't you?
Well... sure...

Eh, what's the harm? All that's left is
getting to Londenion anyway, right?
Okay... just for a little while...
Hehe! Yay!
But just looking at 'em is boring.

Light! Wouldn't that thing feel close to
actually piloting one?
I get it, the simulation.

I've set it up in the cockpit so it's
ready to go anytime!

A simulation? You mean the one for
pilots?
Yeah, it's a lot of fun! Follow me.
Yaaay!
Ah, no fa~ir! I'm going first~!

Looks like we'd better leave this to Tapp
for a while.

Let's do that. More importantly, we need
to make sure nobody else spots us.
Guess we'll stand guard, then.
Ugh!
Ah... did I get hit...?
Yep, that's it!

Hmph! The stick's so big, it doesn't fit
my hand!

Hahaha! Once you've got a normal suit on,
it fits just right.
Oh~ I see!
Still, that was pretty impressive.
Is this really your first time?
Hehe! Sure is.
Let me have a turn now!
Sure! Hang on a sec!

Man, Tapp's really popular with kids,
huh.

How rude! You're the last person I want
to hear that from!
Whoa! When did you get here?!
Ahahaha! She got you there, Kaine!
Quess!
I shot down two of them!
Oh! Then that's the same as me~

(Two kills, huh...... Those two aren't
even pilot cadets, but they're pretty
impressive...)
Shall we get going?
I don't want to go back to the mess!

Why not? All the shuttle passengers are
in there, aren't they?

There's someone among the shuttle
passengers who's kind of hard to be
around.

I see... Then how about the break room we
use? That'd be okay, right?
Yeah! Sounds good.
Then let's go.
Oka~y!
Phew~

You've got it rough too, huh. Hang in
there!
Oh, I will!
Hehe! Feeling this light is great!

Hey! Turn right there! Otherwise you'll
drift right past it!
Huh? Right here...
Aah!
Whoa!
Oh, sorry.
Hm? You must be Miss Quess Paraya.
...Y-Yes!

Civilians had better not go any further
than this.
Sorry about this, Amuro.

Don't worry, I'm taking Quess and
Hathaway to the break room now.
I see. So Hathaway's with you too.
Amurooo! Over heeere!
Yeah, coming!
Lieutenant!
Right. What's the problem?
So that's... Amuro Ray...
Amuro's a Newtype?
Huh? You didn't know?

Hey, did you know? They say he's a
Newtype.

I think... it said something like that
somewhere...

You're kidding, right? I can't believe
it.

Look, Hathaway. Sure, people say Amuro's
a Newtype, but

for regular folks like us, this whole
"Newtype" thing is hard to get, see.
Hathaway, do you know what a Newtype is?

Uh, umm... it's a little hard to explain
in words...
Tell us! Hathaway, how do you see it?
Let's see...

For example, when Amuro got into a mobile
suit for the very first time,

he'd had no real training, but he piloted
it just fine and took down a Zeon Zaku.
Is that for real?

They say just sitting in the cockpit, he
figured out all of the Gundam's
wiring...!

Ahahaha! And that's what you call a
Newtype?
That's right...!
So basically, he's a genius pilot?

N-No... it's not like that... How do I
put it...

Heh heh heh... That's not what Christina
in India told me.

A Newtype is someone who can accurately
perceive the existence of things and
people.

And what's more, they can sense it no
matter how far apart they are.

Yeah, that's right. I think the way you
see it is more accurate, Quess.

(...I don't really get it... Is it
something like being a psychic?)

Well, if you spend time around Amuro,
you'll see he's something special.

It's like he's got eyes in the back of
his head.
So it's true, then?

Yep, yep. When you do mock battles with
Amuro, there's no point hiding.
Huh~ Is that so...

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp] -> 'How come... all of a sudden...?'. Seg 13 [jp] -> 'those guys' (Quess recognising the pilots). Seg 37-39 [jp] -> 'simulation'. Seg 68: Hathaway's [jp] kept impersonal ('hard to be around') -- whose problem it is (presumably Quess's father) is left unstated as in JP. Seg 90 [jp] -> 'Captain' (Chan to Amuro). Seg 94 starts a new scene (break room). Seg 113: [jp] -> 'Christina in India' (not in glossary); [jp] rendered 'told me'. | [editorial 4] 'Hee~' is not an English interjection (reads as a giggle) | [editorial 75] 'Oh, yes!' does not answer 'Hang in there!' naturally | [editorial 122] 'Hee~' is not an English interjection

segments.en: Let's see...
Ah! This way!
So that's it...! The new mobile suit.
Ah!
Hm?
Civilians aren't allowed in here.
I've been in here before!
What about you? Why are you here?
Huh? Why...?
I'm a mechanic on this ship.

That's just the kind of thing a grown-up
would say.
That's not what I'm asking!
I'm asking about you and Amuro Ray!
Y-You and... what...?
He's my superior, and I respect him.
That's not what I mean!!
I trained in India!

So that all of humanity could become
Newtypes who feel for one another!

That's why I was interested in Amuro,
since people say he's a Newtype... but...
Why are you getting in my way?
In your way...?
That's what you are to me!
Why don't you just get off this ship!
I... I can't do that, obviously!
Ah! Quess! You can't go in here!
Shut up!
C'mon, let's go back to the room!
Ah, no!
Quess, take a look. It's a colony!
A colony?
It's Londenion, in Side 1.

Seeing something like this, you can
believe people really can evolve!

No wonder the Zabi family wanted to
declare independence.

But the Zabis' Zeon lost to the Earth
Federation, didn't it?
Yeah, but...

It's been 100 years since the colonies
were built...

and the Federation government still rules
the people living in space from Earth...
Yeah... That's why...

Char sided with Earth once, but now he's
out to crush the Earth with this
operation.
I get that.

People on Earth are stubborn and never
change, but they sure don't mind
changing wives and husbands!

So Char's pulling all sorts of stunts to
show people what humanity can do!

But does that mean it's okay to freeze
the Earth over?
Hmm...
I dunno!

Captain, we've been cleared to enter
port.
Good. Bring the ship into port.

Is Char really serious about freezing the
Earth?
He already went through with round one.

To freeze the Earth completely, he'd have
to drop at least one more rock.

But every rock inside the moon's orbit is
under Federation control... so...!

He'll get them to recognize Sweetwater
as Neo Zeon territory...

And you think high-ranking Federation
officials are gathering at Londenion to
negotiate it?
Yeah, that's how it looks.

Char fought alongside us against the
anti-Federation crowd, but

that showed him what the people left on
Earth are really like, and he got truly
sick of them.
I know that.

So now he's made up his mind to settle
everything once and for all.

Finally here. It's been ages since I got
to stand on solid ground!

Yeah... It's a space colony, but there's
soil and greenery.
Well then, shall we head out?

rows.notes: Seg 13 [jp] -> 'Y-you and... what...?' echoing seg 12's phrasing. Seg 34 [jp] -> 'evolve'. Seg 45 [jp] -> 'freeze the Earth over'. Seg 57: [jp] kept literal ('anti-Federation crowd'); it does not match Zeta canon (Char fought the Titans, a Federation faction) but is translated as written. | [accuracy 22] softening removed: [jp] is Quess ordering Chan off the ship, not a suggestion ('You should')

segments.en:
Come to think of it, I haven't seen Amuro
since we split up at the port...
Where'd he go?
Outskirts of Londenion

(Amuro and the others are taking a
while...)

Excuse me! You're Lieutenant Kanji Akatsuki,
aren't you?
Yes, and you are?
Cameron Bloom, from the Accounting Audit Bureau.

Could you put me through to Captain
Bright?

If you tell him someone from the Accounting
Audit Bureau is here, I think he'll know.
Understood. Please wait here a moment.
So it was you after all... Mr. Cameron.

Sorry to bother you when you're so
busy...

So, what is it you wanted to talk
about...

Mirai... ah, I mean, your wife... is she
well?

I haven't seen her in about six months.
She's been on Earth the whole time.
I see...
Is something wrong...?

I wasn't sure who I ought to tell about
this...

Char Aznable met with high-ranking
Federation officials in this colony.

They believe peace with Char has been
secured.
What?!
Why, that's...

After the Neo Zeon fleet is disarmed at
Luna II,

the Federation government and Neo Zeon
are to sign a peace agreement.
Neo Zeon... is disarming...?
And there's one more thing...

On those conditions, Neo Zeon has bought
Axis.

You're saying the Federation government
sold Axis?

The Federation government says it'll put
the money for Axis toward expanding
welfare programs.

Ridiculous! Even after having Fifth Luna
dropped on them, they still don't get
it!

So that's Captain Bright Noa... Looks
like he and Mirai are doing well.
Ah, Mr. Cameron. Did you finish your business?
Thank you, Kanji.

Thanks to your quick thinking, I got to
meet Captain Bright.

Huh? All I did was pass the message
along.

I want to stop this plan to crush the
Earth, no matter what.
Londo Bell is the last hope we have left.

That's why I'll spare no effort to help
you...!
Thank you very much.

Well then, Kanji, I'll be going. See you
again at Side 7!
At Side 7?! What could he mean by that...

rows.notes: Seg 4 [jp] -> 'Captain Kanji Akatsuki'. Seg 6 [jp] -> 'Audit Bureau'. Seg 10 Bright's [jp] -> 'Cameron' (old acquaintance); seg 32 Kanji's [jp] -> 'Mr. Bloom'. Seg 31 is Cameron's aside after leaving Bright. Seg 23 [jp] -> 'Luna II' (elf_ui form). | [editorial 10] address form: Bright's polite [jp] is 'Mr. Cameron' in row 13 k0; Bright speaks formally to him here | [editorial 32] address form: Kanji's [jp] is 'Mr. Cameron' in row 14 k6/k9 (next unit) | [proofread 8] decided name 'Accounting Audit Bureau' (as in k6); the term_fixes regex misses 'Audit Bureau' split across a line break

segments.en: This ship will now head for Side 7.

In part, it's to keep the Neo Zeon
disarmament at Luna II in check, but

our real aim is to receive equipment for
destroying Axis, just in case.

Destroying Axis... Don't tell me--nuclear
weapons!

The target is Axis, and it's unmanned.
We won't use them against any fleet!
A bitter choice...
Unidentified fleet sighted!
One of the ships is approaching us!
Identify it, now!
Identification complete!
It's a new Federation warship -- Balket-class.
Balket-class? I've never heard of it.
That may be so, sir, but it's right there in the computer's records.
Incoming transmission!
You're Captain Bright of Londo Bell, I take it?
I am Jean-Paul Rochina, commander of the Konpei Island 2nd Fleet.
It's an honor to meet you, sir!
I'll get straight to it. There's something about Neo Zeon I'd like to discuss with you in person.
I'd like to come over to your ship now. Would that be all right?
Yes, sir! We'll prepare for your landing at once.
Thank you. Until then!
Light, can't you find out more about that ship?
What do you think I'm doing right now?!
Dammit! These codes are nothing like any Federation code I've seen before!
For now, could you just tell me what you know so far?
The Federation's newest battleship, the Balket-class...
Its carrying capacity and firepower are both pretty serious, but...
the detailed specs are classified top secret.
So it's definitely a "Federation" ship?
Yeah! It's properly registered.
Kanji...! Is something up with that ship?
Yeah... That ship doesn't belong to the Earth Federation or to Neo Zeon.
The Balket-class is the main class of warship built in Claudia, where I came from.
It's the same class as Binzvanker's flagship...
You mean it's from the fleet you've been chasing, Kanji?
Odds are it is... At the very least, that's one of the ships from the Claudian rebellion.
Federation Salamis-class ships make up most of that fleet... It's probably a mixed force...
But if it's registered as a Federation ship...
that means they've got someone over there hacking into Federation systems, just like me.
Commander Rochina's shuttle will be arriving shortly.
All mobile suit deck personnel, please fall in!
Here he comes!
So this is the Ra Cailum... Impressive, as you'd expect of a new ship.
So that's Commander Rochina...
Check out the uniforms on his escort. You don't see those in the Federation...
That pilot suit... I've seen it somewhere before...
Gah! It's him!!
Hey! You've gotta be kidding me!
What's wrong? Is there somebody you know?
It's Meio Plato! He's our enemy -- you could call him the Giganos Army's ace pilot.
Hm...! It's him!
Hm? What is it, Plato?
I have fought alongside these people on the battlefield.
I would very much like to get better acquainted with them.
Heh... I don't mind. What do you say, Captain Bright?
Yes, I have no objection.
Very well, Plato. Assemble on the deck in 20 minutes.
Yes, sir!
Didn't expect the Practies' little rich boys to tag along too!
Don't get the wrong idea. I have no intention of picking a pointless fight over the Dragonars at this point!
Exactly!! We fight for a greater cause!
Next to the great task ahead, you lot are a trifle.
What was thaaat!!
Kaine, calm down.
Right now we're allies. More importantly, think about the situation we all share!
You're saying we should cooperate...?
That's right, Lieutenant Kanji!
How do you know who I am...?!
I've heard about you from Commander Rochina.
That you're one of Claudia's finest pilots...
Commander Rochina...?
Commander Rochina included, none of us belong to this universe.
And now we're attached to the Federation, fighting a common enemy... I want you to think about what that means.
So us outsiders should all get along, huh?
But listen, we're not fighting 'cause we want to.
If we can get back to our own world, that's all we need.
True, that may be so for you.
But it's different for Kanji, isn't it?
I hear Kanji crossed the wall between worlds of his own accord.
Yeah, that's true. But you know...
You people are working with Binzvanker, right?
I came to this universe from Claudia chasing Binzvanker!
Lieutenant Kanji... I don't know what happened between you and the Supreme Commander in the past.
But once a war is over, even sworn enemies can become comrades.
Supreme Commander...? So it IS Binzvanker's army!
He's the man who staged a coup d'etat in Claudia!!
I've heard enough out of you lot! How dare you talk that way to our captain!
Captain! There's no need to take riffraff like this seriously!
Now, now, that's enough...
In our original world, I was on the opposite side from the Dragonar Team here.
But now, they are not our opponents.
At least for the time being, neither His Excellency Rochina nor I consider you an enemy.
We may not be able to reconcile right away, but I'd like you to keep this in mind...
Hey, Kanji, you'd better not trust them.
These guys are rotten to the core!
We lead fulfilling lives under a wise and generous superior.
Lieutenant Kanji! You are not like these Dragonar Team thugs.
I don't know how you came to be traveling with them, but
these three are nothing but punks who stole our army's Dragonars!
Enough, Welner!
They're already skilled pilots.
You should know that from firsthand experience!
Ngh!
We are no longer Giganos. Forget the old grudges.
But...!
Listen! For convenience, we each refer to one another's worlds as "other worlds."
But now that the doors between worlds have been revealed, this world has become one!
An age has come in which we must seek a new view of the world.
We must think more deeply about what that means.
Our fleet is currently heading for the lunar sector.
That way, if Neo Zeon resists, we can seize Sweetwater at once.
I see. So the Federation's regular fleets are finally on the move.
No... They may be moving, but it's only part of the force.
Many fleets can't move, as they're busy keeping an eye on rebellions in the colonies.
We're being forced to deal with an extremely difficult situation.
I agree...
However, many forces not belonging to Neo Zeon remain in this universe.
I need your Londo Bell unit to keep responding flexibly to situations, as you have so far.
Understood, sir!
Beyond that, the matter of the Federation government handing over Axis concerns me...
So you think so too, Commander...
Yes. I suspect Char intends to start something.
But don't you think it's too blatant for one of Char's schemes?
Indeed. His goal may be to lure us out into the Axis sector.
In that case, it would be reasonable to assume Char aims to split up our forces...
Exactly, Captain Bright.
The attacking side always holds the advantage of choosing where to strike.
An attacker can concentrate forces on a single "point," while the defender must cover a whole "area."
Meaning the wider the area the defenders must cover, the more they need forces several times the enemy's.
That is the reality the Earth Federation faces...
But my fleet has its hands full just covering the lunar sector.
I'll send a squadron to Axis just in case, but that won't be enough to defend it.
If only Char truly wanted peace, this would all turn out to be needless worry.
Even a small force should be able to raise the alarm from Axis.
As for Axis, Londo Bell is taking action of its own.
We intend to stop any operation to crush the Earth, whatever it takes.
Impressive. That's a relief to hear.
I'll cooperate as much as I can. You can leave the aftermath to me.
Then I'm counting on you, Captain Bright!
Yes, sir!
The Ra Cailum seems to be a fine unit.
They make good use of youthful energy and seem to fight above their true ability.
Someone like me has much to learn from them.
Indeed...!
They're gone...
Who'd have thought the Practies would be on our side...
Kanji, what do you make of those guys?
What their captain, Meio Plato, said makes sense.
If there's room to talk things out, we shouldn't be fighting...
Whoa, whoa, are you serious?
No... I've got no intention of joining hands with Binzvanker.
He's holding up false ideals... just to achieve his own ambitions.
Still... you've got nothing to prove that.
Even false ideals become true if enough people believe in them and rally behind them.
If they had enough military strength to stage a coup,
that means they had a just cause to match.
Grr...! So all I can do is sit and watch his forces grow stronger?!
He's a tough one to go up against... We don't have any political clout at all.
Still, I'm gonna lend Kanji a hand.
After all, we only ended up in this world because those guys connected the worlds in the first place.
I'm gonna make 'em pay for that in full!
Yeah, you said it. I believe what Kanji says, too.
In the end, it's not about logic, is it?
Guess it's fate. I'm with you till the end!
Thanks, everyone.
Don't get all formal on us! We're friends, aren't we?
That's right!
I'll dig up some info on Commander Rochina's fleet for you.
Anyway, for now let's deal with the enemy right in front of us!
Yeah... Right now we're up against Neo Zeon...
We have to protect all the people living on Earth.

rows.notes: Seg 4 (no header): read as the Londo Bell operator continuing the ID report. Seg 9: [jp] = Konpei Island (as in the existing machine-library draft). [jp] (Rochina) = Commander; [jp] (Binzvanker) = Supreme Commander; [jp] = His Excellency. Meio's [jp] = 'Captain Kanji' (matches Kanji's library rank); [jp] (Meio, from Karl/Welner/Kanji) = 'captain' as unit leader. Seg 70-72: Meio's '[jp]' rendered as plain 'Kanji' (third person, talking to Kaine). Seg 52: [jp] = 'the Practies' little rich boys'; glossary spelling Practies is low confidence. Seg 82 [jp] (Meio, calming his men) = 'Now, now, that's enough...'. Seg 99: [jp] -- rendered as each side calling the others' worlds 'other worlds'. Seg 126: 1[jp] = 'a squadron'. Seg 135: [jp] = 'unit' (Rochina praising the Ra Cailum's crew). Seg 146 speaker header repeats Kanji (continuation). | [accuracy 44] source [jp] is singular (one person Meio recognizes, as Kaine's 'It's him!!' just before); 'them' was added. All Dragonar pilots and Kanji are male, so 'him' is safe | [accuracy 152] [jp] = the opponent is too tough for us, not that we are fighting the wrong person | [editorial 6] 'You can say that, sir' is unidiomatic for [jp] | [editorial 16] rhetorical question needs question punctuation | [editorial 18] per accuracy flag: [jp] = just what is known now, not further digging | [editorial 26] 'a main warship' awkward for [jp] | [editorial 80] Karl's [jp]! made explicit (accuracy flag); force restored | [editorial 99] tautology 'calls the other worlds other worlds' clarified (accuracy flag) | [editorial 100] 'is already one' unnatural for [jp]...[jp] (accuracy flag) | [editorial 107] 'Even if they're moving, it's only some of the units' clumsy | [editorial 109] 'respond in an extremely difficult position' awkward (accuracy flag) | [editorial 123] 'the more they need several times the enemy's strength' clumsy (accuracy flag) | [editorial 136] 'their young people's strength' awkward for [jp] | [proofread 61] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en: Only four or five tries, and look at that...! She's the real thing!
Yes. The link between Quess's brainwaves and the psycommu is perfect.
Quess, you know the target, don't you?
Yes!
From here, the Funnels will move in automatically.
Yes.
Release Funnels.
Yes.
Just like that girl...

rows.notes: Seg 4: [jp] -- 'move in' for [jp]. Seg 9: [jp] kept as 'that girl' (Char's memory; not named in source). | [editorial 1] term: project decision is lowercase 'psycommu'

segments.en: We've arrived at "Side 7."
We've been cleared to enter port.
All right, we're going in!
Whoa... Look at that! The flagship Rewloola, making a grand triumphant return!
Long live Neo Zeon!!
Long live Neo Zeeeon!!
Don't get carried away!!
The war's not over yet!
We're starting maintenance on the whole fleet now!!
Team B, check the hull immediately!
Move the damaged mobile suits to Block 2!
Wow~ So this is Sweetwater?!
Oh right, this is your first time here, Quess.
Gyunei, I'm counting on you for the operation starting tomorrow!
Yes, sir!
Quess, did you get any headaches during training?
Nope, of course not!!
Are you sure? The operation starting tomorrow is no game...
Of course!
I see......
...Colonel?
Get some good rest today...
Okay!
Gyunei, show her around.
Understood!
The gravity block's up ahead. Your quarters are at a military facility on the outskirts, Quess, so...
Before that, show me around the city!
W-Well... The operation starts up again tomorrow.
You need to get some good rest today...
Hehe~ You really want to go too, don't you, Gyunei!
Are you really okay? You just had psycommu training, right?
Hehehe...! I'm totally fine!
There's no beating you, Quess... Okay, I'll take you anywhere you want.
Yaaay!
Everything is going according to plan so far... Londo Bell... what will your move be?
It's finally happening, Colonel...
Yes. With this, mankind can move on to a new era.
That's true.
But... Colonel?
What is it?
Just dropping Axis on Earth will do damage on the same scale as a nuclear winter.
That's an atrocity no dictator has ever committed.
Are you sure about this, Colonel Char?
It's a little late for a sermon, Nanai...
I believe in the evolution of mankind that has gone out into space.
But to turn all of mankind into Newtypes...
someone has to take mankind's sins upon themselves.
Are you sure about this?
You came up with this operation because you want to show up that Amuro, didn't you?
Am I such a small man?
Amuro Ray is a man who mistakenly believes kindness is a Newtype's weapon.
A woman could forgive a man like that, but you can't forgive Amuro for it, Colonel.
(Just because I can sense the will of others, if only imperfectly...)
What's wrong?
People who are too much alike end up hating each other...
So love turned into a hundredfold hate?
Heh... Something like that.
I'm counting on you for tomorrow's operation, Nanai.
Yes...
I'll go ahead to Axis and wait for you there.
Quess... Are you sure about her?
I don't think she needs any more enhancement than that...?
Yes...
That girl is a Newtype who can control Funnels even without using the Psycho-Frame.
I suppose she is...
I'd like to think his resolve to inherit Zeon Deikun's name changed the Colonel, but...
Dammit!
Letting a little girl like that distract him...!
The Colonel's just using the war as an outlet for his frustrations.
When guys like the Colonel blow their top, they go and do stuff like smashing colonies.
What does that mean...?!
At times like that, somebody needs the power to stop him, right?
That's why I had them enhance me into a Newtype.
My parents... got killed when a colony was smashed...
Hmm... So that's why you want to become an esper, Gyunei.
Yeah... but
I figured out the Newtype Lab's enhancement can't make me like you, Quess.
So I'm gonna go out with you, Quess, and get to study you.
You mean you want to go out with me?
Does the age difference bother you?
Ah...! You're jealous because I like the Colonel!
That's not it!
Quess!

rows.notes: Seg 47: [jp] = 'the evolution of mankind that has gone out into space' (CCA theme of 'innovation'). Seg 49: [jp] = 'sins'. Seg 56: [jp]...[jp] -- 'half sense' renders [jp] (imperfectly); sentence trails off as in source. Seg 59: [jp] idiom kept as 'love turned into a hundredfold hate'. Seg 70-72: Nanai's private thoughts about Char (no parentheses in source). Seg 78: [jp] = 'smashing colonies' / 'a colony was smashed'. Seg 80-81: sentence split across pages kept ('Yeah... but' / continuation). | [editorial 33] term: project decision is lowercase 'psycommu' | [editorial 35] 'I can't win against you' stiff for [jp] | [editorial 56] 'half sense' unclear; [jp] = imperfect ability, trailing kept | [editorial 73] 'venting his frustrations on the war' makes the war the target; [jp] = war is the outlet

segments.en: Looks like Mr. Cameron hasn't arrived yet.
We're checking the port authority's schedule now.
Found it!
A regular shuttle run under the Accounting Audit Bureau seems to be heading here from Side 6.
That's the one...
I want the loading done as quickly as possible.
Have the cargo hold cleared out before it arrives.
Understood!
Looks like there's a little time before we leave port.
Guess I'll do some maintenance until then.

rows.notes: [jp] = Accounting Audit Bureau (as in Cameron's library entry). [jp] = 'regular shuttle run'.

segments.en: What's that? Sounds noisy over by the port...
Hey! Out of the way, out of the way!
You there! Quit dawdling!
Yessiiir!!
Even Kaine and the guys... What's going on?
Hey there, Kanji!
Oh, Mr. Cameron. What's all this commotion?
They're moving the cargo over from the freighter.
It's unofficial, you see. I imagine everyone's pitching in to finish as fast as possible.
Did you arrange all this, Mr. Cameron? But you're with the Accounting Audit Bureau...
That's exactly why it's unofficial. I brought supplies Londo Bell needs.
Mostly things the military doesn't issue. I brought everything I could arrange.
I see. Thank you very much.
Don't mention it. I'm doing this because I want to.
Heeey! Where've you been, Kanji?!
Hurry up and give us a hand!
Okay, okay!!

rows.notes: Seg 1-2: generic Londo Bell Member barking at the loading crew. Seg 3: Kaine's mock-cheerful [jp] = 'Yessiiir!!'. | [proofread 14] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en: So that's the Rewloola...
But... can a dummy like this really fool them?
Navy types feel safe as long as the number of ships adds up...
With a fleet padded out with dummies we strike Luna II, and meanwhile you yourself advance on Axis, Colonel.
If all goes well, we may even be able to use Luna II's nuclear weapons.
Yes...
Both to accelerate Axis, and to contaminate the Earth...
How many nuclear weapons from the old century are stockpiled at Luna II?
Enough to annihilate Neo Zeon's fleet a hundred times over.
Char knows that. He's a wise man.
Are you saying that we in Londo Bell want a war?
Yes, that's how it looks from Earth.
Vice Chief of Staff! A Neo Zeon fleet appears to have left port at Sweetwater.
Good! Can we see footage?
On the upper monitor...
So the flagship Rewloola's at the rear...
The numbers match.
Ah... no, wait... There's one more ship than reported!
Char's an honest man.
To think there were 15 nuclear warheads outside of Luna II...
But since they fell under the Accounting Audit Bureau, they're museum pieces.
Please be careful...
Won't you be charged with a crime?
If the current Federation government survives, I'll get life in prison.
Are you sure about this?
I'm doing this because I want Mirai to live.
As her former fiance, you have that right.
Thank you...
I've gathered you all here so that you understand that, in the operation about to begin,
we may use sealed nuclear weapons.
You can't be serious...!
But wouldn't that be pretty much the same thing Char did?
Hold on. The captain has his reasons. We should hear him out first, right?
Thanks, Kayra. Now, let me continue.
The operation I'm about to explain will not be carried out if Neo Zeon and the Federation make a complete peace.
If everything goes peacefully, we will be charged with illegally handling nuclear weapons.
But I will take full responsibility for that!
We don't have any other options left now.
Bright, get to the heart of the operation.
Right.
As you know, Axis is a resource asteroid far more massive than Fifth Luna.
If it hits the Earth's surface, it will certainly plunge the planet into a cold age.
Even if we tactically repel the Neo Zeon fleet...
as long as Axis is drifting in the Earth Sphere, the Earth will still be in danger...
Therefore, this operation's main objective is to destroy Axis itself!
The equipment you all loaded today includes 15 nuclear warheads.
However, they're old-generation weapons, each built to a different standard.
To use them in combat, we have to modify them to work as warheads for current missiles.
...For these reasons, we'll first head to "La Vie en Rose."
That's all. Any questions?!
Then all hands, to your stations. This ship is now leaving port!

rows.notes: Seg 0-6: Neo Zeon High Official and Char; seg 0 refers to the dummy of the Rewloola. Seg 7-19: Federation side; [jp] = 'Undersecretary' (title used to address the Senior Official). Seg 10: source has an Earth Federation Officer say [jp] -- kept literally. Seg 19: [jp] kept as the official's (ironic) 'Char's an honest man.' Seg 21: [jp] -- read as warheads held under the Audit Bureau's records, i.e. obsolete stock. Seg 45: [jp] = 'plunge the planet into a cold age'. Seg 44: [jp] = 'resource asteroid'. | [editorial 30] page-split sentence restructured for flow; cut point unchanged | [editorial 31] continuation of k30 restructure

segments.en: We will now begin modifying the nuclear warheads.
All staff other than engineers are prohibited from entering the work block!
Now, what should I do...
Looks like they're done modifying the warheads.
So we're finally setting out for Axis...
Neo Zeon fleet confirmed!
Same number of ships as when they left Sweetwater!
Captain! Why isn't our Clop moving to the front?!
That's rude to Char!
I have to ensure the flagship's safety!
Direct visual coming up!
They're spreading out sideways...
They should be coming in single file...
Launch a recon plane!!
Sir! The Rewloola is a dummy!!
Damn! They're dispersing Minovsky particles!
They mean to fight!!
Impossible! That's a treaty violation!!
Quess! All you need to do is get a feel for real combat. Follow me!
Roger!
Amazing...
I'll clean this up all by myself!
Gyunei!!
Aah!
Damn it!!
Hah... hah...
So this is war...! Gyunei...
Grr! I can take on the Federation single-handed!!
A total victory without even going to the combat bridge!
Now we can deliver Luna II's nukes to the Colonel.
Yes, things are going to get busy.
Colonel... your plan is perfect.
An alarm?! What happened?!!
Kanji! Luna II got hit by a surprise attack! The enemy's on the move!
Everyone here? We're leaving port right away!!
Are we going to help Luna II?
Only part of the enemy fleet attacked Luna II!
Their main force is already at Axis!
Wait, you don't mean we're taking on an enemy fleet with battleships in it using just the fleet we've got here?
Not all of Neo Zeon's fleet has gathered at Axis!
As long as we destroy Axis, Char's plan fails!
So the idea is to charge in before the whole enemy force gathers...!
Looks like that's about the size of it...
So that's why... we need the nuclear warheads...
At least we'll be using them on an unmanned asteroid. That's some comfort.
Even so, I bet some people will get caught up in it...
This is rough...

rows.notes: Seg 4: [jp] = our Clop (Clop-class flagship); speaker is the self-serving senior official. Seg 9: [jp] (single-column approach) = 'coming in single file'. Seg 11: [jp] = 'Sir!' (rank unclear). Seg 25: [jp]1[jp] = 'with my unit alone' (unit = his mobile suit). Seg 42: [jp] rendered 'asteroid' (Axis). | [editorial 25] 'with my unit alone' reads as his squad; [jp] = him alone | [editorial 36] double 'with' made the line hard to parse | [editorial 39] 'all the enemies gather' unnatural | [proofread 30] question punctuation: a direct question ended in '!' only; '?' added per style sheet ('?!')

segments.en:
Captain Bright, we have a transmission
from Commander Rochina.

I take it you've already heard
about Luna II?
Yes, sir. And as for Axis...

We just heard from the fleet we'd sent
to Axis. Char's main force is at Axis!

Unfortunately, it seems our fleet
has been wiped out...

Our fleet is heading for Axis as well,
but it'll take time for us to catch up.

Until then, I need you to hold Axis
back somehow.

Understood, sir! We'll destroy
the nuclear nozzles before Axis
can use them!
I'm counting on you!
That is all!!

The nuclear missiles are all loaded,
I take it?
Yes, sir, every one of them is loaded!

Good. The fleet will now make
all haste to Axis!!
Both engines, full speed!!

rows.notes: [jp] -> Commander Rochina. [jp] -> nuclear nozzles (Axis's nuclear-pulse thrusters). [jp] -> 'Both engines, full speed'.

segments.en:
A large-scale fleet battle is about
to begin.
Lun... I swear I'll make it back alive.

Everyone in Claudia... hang in there
until I get back!

We'll be entering the Axis combat zone
shortly.
All personnel, prepare to launch.
So this is it...

Hm? Isn't that the Dragonar Team
over there? Looks like they're arguing
about something...
Hey! What's going on?!
Hathaway stowed away on the ship!
Ah... Kanji.

Hathaway...! Didn't you get off
the ship at Londenion?

...Yes... It was at Londenion that
I slipped aboard this ship.

So you haven't told the captain...
your dad, I mean.

I lied to my father... I just had
to be on this ship, no matter what!

I see... You've been hiding this whole
time, huh. You must be pretty
determined, but still...

Hathaway... This ship is about to head
into a fierce battle. Do you understand
that?
I'm prepared for that!

I have to go to Axis
to get Quess back!

Quess... You mean that girl
who was with you?
What about Quess?

Quess... Quess went off
with Char!

At Londenion... right in front of me
and Amuro...!
What?!

Went off with Char?
What's that supposed to mean?
That's...
Come on, just tell us.
Okay...

Even if Quess did go to Sweetwater
with Char...

that doesn't mean she'd go to Axis,
does it?

Yeah. Quess is a civilian, so there's
no way she'd be with the fleet.

Especially not somewhere that's about
to become the fiercest battlefield...

They're making Quess fly
as a pilot.
I just... know it, somehow...

No way! That wildcat,
a pilot?

Even if she's got talent, I can't see
them putting her right on the front
line...

Quess is a Newtype! That's why
Char was able to lead her astray!

So they make her a pilot just
because she's a Newtype?

If that's true, I won't stand for it.
We'll just have to rescue her ourselves!
Yeah!

But hey... are we just gonna keep
hiding Hathaway like this?

At this point, we can't exactly
put him off the ship.

But we can't keep Captain Bright
in the dark either.

Yeah... There's no guarantee
this ship won't sink.

You'd better see your father before
it's too late.
Right!
Ugh!

With you out here too, what's going
to happen to your mother and Cheimin?!

A boy ought to have
this much spirit.
This is no joke!!

You want to see Quess,
Hathaway?
I'm going to get Quess back!
Hathaway...

Char is exploiting Quess's gift --
she senses far too much.
Exploiting her? But...

Her talent has been enhanced, and now
she's been reduced to a tool for Char.

Char is a man who can only remake
the world on top of people's deaths.

And Quess, used by a man like that,
will be dragged by the power of the dead
to a tragic end...

Quess isn't going to die! I'll get
her back before that happens!!

That's why I even learned
how to pilot a mobile suit!!

With that attitude, Hathaway, you'll
be dragged off by the dead too!
Nngh...!

Amuro, it's time we headed
to the bridge.
Chan, keep Hathaway confined.
Understood.

You sure are reckless.
Come on, let's go.

If anything happens, I'll contact you
on the headset. Got it?!
Yes, ma'am!

Yo! Hathaway! Did your old man
chew you out?

Hold on! Don't tell me
you guys knew?!

Well, we couldn't exactly toss him
out into space, could we?

L-Lieutenant Kanji...
You too...

Well, he's here now, so there's
nothing we can do about it.

Hathaway, we'll bring
Quess back for you!
Kaine...

Sigh... The fate of the Earth rides
on this battle, and...

One person's whole life rides on it
too, doesn't it?

Quess isn't some girl who has nothing
to do with us.

It may look like we're fooling around,
but we're serious.
Kanji...

Oh, Chan, something's glowing
at your waist.
Huh?

What's that? That T-shaped
thing.

Oh, this is... the Psycho-Frame
we use in the Gundam.

There was something about its
performance I wanted to check, so I've
been carrying it around, but...

It looked like it was...
resonating with something...

Resonating...? But with what,
I wonder...

Hmm... Just looks like a hunk
of iron to me...
Maybe it's a Newtype detector!
Here! Light, is it you?
H-Hey, cut it out!

It might be giving off
dangerous waves!
Hey, give that back!!
Kanji, it's you, isn't it?

Whoa, don't shove it on me!!
I'm all tingly~~~

Give it back!
It's not a toy!
Honestly, you guys!

I'll examine the Psycho-Frame
properly myself!

Well then, Hathaway!
Behave yourself.
Okaaay!

And you lot -- don't go taking
Hathaway out on your own.
Roger!
Well, we'd better get going too.

We'll come see you again
when we get back!

rows.notes: Seg 10/11: Hathaway was supposed to leave at Londenion and instead slipped aboard there. [jp] -> Londenion, [jp] -> Sweetwater, [jp] -> Cheimin (Hathaway's sister), [jp] -> Claudia: none in glossary, official CCA / project forms used. Seg 73: [jp] -> Captain Kanji ([jp] = Captain per library precedent 'Captain Min'). Seg 68: Chan will contact Hathaway via [jp] (headset), rendered 'headset'. Seg 94: [jp] kept literal ('dangerous waves'); the slang sense 'crazy' is not carried. | [editorial 55] 'reduced to Char's tool' unidiomatic

segments.en:
Prepare to fire
dummy missiles!!
Prepare to fire missiles!

Control now transfers
to the combat bridge!!

Disperse Minovsky particles
at combat density!!

All hands!
Prepare for visual-range combat!

Londo Bell...
You're later than I expected.
Moving heat sources approaching!!
Prepare to intercept!!

Open the combat bridge!
Launch the MS squads!!

Naval gunfire!!
Incoming!!

Right!
Commence interception!!

First wave of missiles!
Fire!!
Here they come!!
Intercept! Lay down a barrage!!
Hmm!!

There was a nuke among
the missiles...?!
Not bad, Londo Bell!!

Right!
Mobile suit squads, launch!!

rows.notes: [editorial 9] 'Ship cannon fire' awkward; natural military phrasing | [editorial 13] bare noun 'Barrage!!' read as a label; made it a spoken order

segments.en: Not bad, Londo Bell.
However!

Go, Axis! Along with all
those loathsome memories...!
Ah!

Axis has ignited!
It's begun its descent to Earth!
Not yet!

Release the dummies!
Evasive maneuvers at the same time!

Fire the fifth wave of missiles!
Fiiire!

Only one nuclear missile
in this wave as well.
Not bad, Bright...

Nanai...
hurry and get here.

Mobile suit squads, hit the enemy fleet
from the flank! Support the Colonel!!

Once the mobile suits launch, we'll give
30 seconds of covering fire!
Aren't we thorough...
Good luck to you all.
Yeah, yeah.

Londo Bell should stick to
ringing its little bells!

Heat source to the right!
It's the enemy!

So they're reinforcements
from Luna II!!

rows.notes: Seg 2: [jp] = Rezin sneering at Nanai's thoroughness. Seg 5: pun on the name Londo Bell kept. | [editorial 7] verb restored to Bright's realisation (accuracy flag suggestion)

segments.en:
Tch!!
Gyunei's squad still isn't here?!

Rezin!
Fall back!!
Enemy mobile suits repelled!!

Londo Bell
mobile suits?
No, missiles...!

These are
nuclear missiles!

The missiles!
Every one of them was shot down!!
New enemy fleet detected!!
So this is as far as we can go...

Retreat signal...!
The fleet will fall back for now!

Kanji!
We're pulling out.

Are we really just going to back off
like this?!

Axis has already started to fall,
you know!

We still have options!
Right now we need to regroup.
Roger...

The Londo Bell fleet
is withdrawing.

We'll regroup our fleet as well.
Recover the mobile suit squads.
The first wave has passed.
Good work, Colonel.

Gyunei stopped the enemy's
nuclear missiles for us.

That is the work
of a cyber-Newtype.

A second wave will probably
be coming.
Indeed...

Londo Bell is desperate too. Next
time they'll come ready to throw their
lives away.

rows.notes: Seg 21: [jp] -> cyber-Newtype (glossary position wording for Gyunei).
